findings.conclusion: The cap is a user-authorized runtime amendment during execution. The first33 frozen-manifest scenes provide a method-balanced prefix, not a representative or domain-balanced replacement for the original80-scene cohort. The saved real summaries describe33 scenes in12 provenance groups:30 DeepShip scenes in9 groups and3 MBARI scenes in3 groups.

All nine real-cohort conditions have zero eligible-reference-scored episodes and unavailable event metrics. Differences in emission, geometric duplicate candidates, token counts or recorded spans do not establish real detection accuracy or graph/DEMON/quantitative-evidence benefits. H1 comparator selection and H4 remain unavailable.

no_graph and no_quantitative each have33 empty final reports, zero schema failures and33 completed executions. These are completed schema-valid outcomes; they must not be labelled crashed or schema-rejected episodes.

declared_abstention is read from the retained final report, whose abstained field is set by the verifier from accepted components. In the cited no_quantitative example the raw model reports components and abstained=false, while all components are withheld and final abstained=true. The cited no_graph example is already empty/abstained in the raw model output. These mechanisms must not be conflated or interpreted as physical correctness.

The synthetic comparison contains only F,G4 and schema-gated no_verifier, all reusing main inference. There are zero new synthetic inference calls. The six intended synthetic ablation variants are omitted, so this comparison cannot establish their accuracy effects.

Saved exact synthetic no_verifier metrics are TP12/FP27/FN12, precision0.3076923191547394, recall0.5, F1=0.380952388048172. F has TP12/FP11/FN12, precision0.52173912525177, recall0.5, F1=0.5106382966041565. This is a descriptive paired-output comparison of the numeric filter after the same schema gate; do not substitute raw_F metrics TP13/FP32/FN11, which include predictions from the schema-rejected report.

Saved synthetic duplicate-candidate counts are3 for F and10 for no_verifier. Saved real counts are1 and4 respectively. These are geometric duplicate diagnostics on final/schema-gated outputs, not independently verified source duplication or an aggregate raw-to-final diagnostic from the original main report.

F,G4,no_verifier each have12 exact generator/provenance groups. Their saved2000-draw individual-method intervals describe group sampling under one frozen model. They are neither paired-effect intervals nor model-seed variability. G4 F1=0.6415094137191772 is descriptive; no significance, equivalence or nonsignificance follows from comparing marginal intervals. No post-test fixed-comparator selection is performed.

F and no_verifier inherit identical saved compute and token accounting. F/G4 reused reports are not fresh inference. Capped variants combine preserved original executions with resumed jobs; artifacts from interrupted partial work remain in the original run, while completed-episode aggregates do not recover its full computation cost. Per-method spans are incomplete schedule-specific equal-share accounting, not measured verifier savings, exclusive per-request latency or additional billable runtime. The earlier unlocked-verifier/overlapping-span explanation is withdrawn by the linked correction.

Exact scores retain frozen greedy one-to-one matching and declared modulation/optional-beat scope. The common overlap score is geometry-induced temporal overlap, not emitted relation or free-text reasoning correctness. Secondary relation and morphology exports were not included in this transfer and remain separate.
